description: The Center for Medical Cannabis and Psilocybin hosted the first Training and Education Committee for the Medical Psilocybin Advisory Board. The Chair, Brenda Burgard, established the committee's purpose and presented a two-part draft framework: Part 1- Education and Part 2- Training.
